title: Area: Online Uk
content:
Online GCSE science tuition, anywhere in England and Wales

Online GCSE Combined Science tuition anywhere in England and Wales, from a former Head of Science in Leeds. Taught by Rod Martin — an expert science tutor and former Head of Science with over twenty years in UK classrooms.

Science tuition around Online across England & Wales

Rod teaches from Leeds, but a screen does not care where anyone is sitting. Students join from anywhere in England and Wales — the sessions are live and taught, not recorded videos handed over. Scotland is the one place not covered, and for a real reason: Scottish students sit National 5 and Highers rather than GCSEs, which is a different qualification with a different specification.

Online works because the material suits it. Past papers can be shared on screen and annotated together, diagrams get drawn live, and a student can be asked to explain something back with nowhere to hide — which is the moment you find out whether it has landed.

Three ways to work together

Whichever suits the student in front of me — not whichever is easiest to sell.
